faq.q: Do I own the generated images?
faq.a: Yes. You hold full commercial rights to every image generated from your garment photos.
Major platforms require AI disclosure rather than banning AI images. Our C2PA + EXIF metadata satisfies these disclosure rules — and looks professional doing it.

faq.q: How close is the garment reproduction?
faq.a: Each generation runs an automated QA pass checking garment fidelity, color accuracy and logo preservation. Images below threshold are flagged for review before you download.
Failed generations are automatically refunded — credits return to your balance instantly, subscription quota is released.
